theorems.name: Submission.deGiorgiRH_hausdorff_density_of_approxTangent
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (M : Set (Rn N)) (x : Rn N) (P : Submodule ℝ (Rn N)), (∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ μHE[n] (M ∩ Metric.closedBall x δ) < ∞) → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x P → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ μHE[n] (M ∩ Metric.closedBall x ρ) / ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (volume (Metric.ball (0 : Rn n) 1)))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
